newsitem.title: USA: Grant Geophysical seeking strategic moves.
newsitem.headline: Grant Geophysical seeking strategic moves.

text.p: Grant Geophysical Inc said Thursday it had hired an investment banker and is considering a restructuring of its existing capital structure and other strategic moves.
The company hired Salomon Brothers Inc to advise it.
Grant Geophysical said the move is part of its overall effort to increase working capital, improve its value and position the company for growth.
There are no assurances the company will complete a transaction toward that end, it said.
